tenderSchedule.title: The Project Director, Bangalore South District invites Two Cover detailed tenders from ISO Certified Professional Consultants based on QCBS For Providing Services as 3rd Party (Third Party) Inspection and Monitoring for all Development & Maintenance Works, Procurement of Goods & Services Works under Various Funds for Ramanagara CMC, Channapatna CMC , Kanakapura CMC, Magadi TMC, Bidadi TMC, Harohalli TP, of Bangalore South District ULBs for the year 2026-27.
tenderSchedule.description: The Project Director, Bangalore South District invites Two Cover detailed tenders from ISO Certified Professional Consultants based on QCBS For Providing Services as 3rd Party (Third Party) Inspection and Monitoring for all Development & Maintenance Works, Procurement of Goods & Services Works under Various Funds for Ramanagara CMC, Channapatna CMC , Kanakapura CMC, Magadi TMC, Bidadi TMC, Harohalli TP, of Bangalore South District ULBs for the year 2026-27.
tenderSchedule.locationName: DMA District Urban Development Cell Ramanagara

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2025-26
All the documents as per Bid Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract each Bidder in its name should have Satisfactory completed as prime Bidder, carried out similar kind of Works as a 3rd party for inspection of projects/ works Cost of Minimum Rs 75.0 CRORES in any One Year, in any Govt Departments, in last Five years period (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 ,2024-25, & 2025-26)
The agency shall be an Indian company/ firm (It must be registered under particular act (GOI/GOK). Also, agency should have valid ISO 9001: 2015 certificate
The Firm or Company should have minimum Annual Turnover of Rs 86.04 lakhs in any 2 financial years in the last 05 years (2021-22, 2022-23 2023-24 2024-25 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Key professional staff as mentioned in bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Resumes of key professional staff with certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Agency should have Own or leased fully equipped National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratory (NABL) for Quality assurance of Civil, Electrical & Mechanical application usage materials, in Karnataka State also Own or leased fully equipped Quality Analysis Mobile Laboratory for Quality assurance of Civil, Electrical & Mechanical application usage materials / tied-up with NABL Laboratory and mobile Laboratory document for the same should be submitted. (The laboratory should have scope of coarse Aggregate, Fine Aggregate, Cement, Bricks, Blocks, Soil, Asphalt, Steel & NDT,)
